mapper.sql: select t.*, i.project_name, w.wbs_name work_package_name, parent_wbs.wbs_name, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name) assignee_name, u.user_name assignee_code, u.user_name assignee_user_name, (select count(*) from pm_project_task c where c.parent_task_id = t.task_id) child_count from pm_project_task t join pm_project i on i.project_id = t.project_id join pm_project_wbs_node w on w.wbs_id = t.work_package_id left join pm_project_wbs_node parent_wbs on parent_wbs.wbs_id = w.parent_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.assignee_user_id and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where t.work_package_id = #{packageId} and t.parent_task_id = #{parentId} order by t.sort_order, t.task_id
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_task(project_id, work_package_id, parent_task_id, task_code, task_type, task_name, description, assignee_id, assignee_user_id, plan_start_date, plan_end_date, estimated_hours, actual_hours, priority, status, progress, sort_order, create_by, create_time) values(#{projectId}, #{workPackageId}, #{parentTaskId}, #{taskCode}, #{taskType}, #{taskName}, #{description}, #{assigneeId}, #{assigneeId}, #{planStartDate}, #{planEndDate}, #{estimatedHours}, #{actualHours}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{progress}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update pm_project_task set task_name = #{taskName}, description = #{description}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, assignee_user_id = #{assigneeId}, plan_start_date = #{planStartDate}, plan_end_date = #{planEndDate}, estimated_hours = #{estimatedHours}, actual_hours = #{actualHours}, priority = #{priority}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from pm_project_task where parent_task_id = #{id}
mapper.update: update pm_project_task set status = #{status}, progress = #{progress}, actual_start_date = #{actualStartDate}, actual_end_date = #{actualEndDate}, pause_reason = #{pauseReason}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_task_output(task_id, output_name, file_url, description, create_by, create_time) values(#{taskId}, #{outputName}, #{fileUrl}, #{description}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select l.log_id, l.task_id, l.action, l.from_status, l.to_status, l.remark, l.operator_user_id, coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name, ''), l.operator_name) operator_name, l.operation_time from pm_project_task_operation_log l left join sys_user u on u.user_id = l.operator_user_id where l.task_id = #{taskId} order by l.operation_time desc, l.log_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into pm_project_task_operation_log(task_id, action, from_status, to_status, remark, operator_user_id, operator_name, operation_time) values(#{taskId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{remark}, #{operatorUserId}, #{operatorName}, #{operationTime})
